name: System Goddess
source:
The System Goddess is a goddess who has encountered Rance in his journeys, though it is unknown if his these meetings are canon or not. She is in charge of saving, loading, and changing system options in your game.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/System_Goddess]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
